This supplementary material contains 12 pages including 3 tables, 6 figures and References.
Table S1. Oligonucleotide probes and primers and qPCR conditions for bacteria (16S and rpoB), ARGs and AMRs.
Figure S1. Oxidation reduction potential (ORP) of the five reactors. Error bar represents the standard deviation of 4 stages’ last cycles.
Figure S2. COD removal efficiency in the last cycle of each stage. Error bar represents standard deviation of two measurements.
Figure S3. Ratio of CO2/CH4 in the biogas. Error bar represents standard deviation of two measurements.
Figure S4. Assemblage of the top 10 genera from each reactor. Taxon names are shown at genus level, or higher level if not identified, family level (D_4), order level (D_3), and class level (D_2).

Figure S5. Canonical Correspondence Analysis (CCA) between microbial community and ARGs’ abundances. Class 1 integrase gene (intI1), IncP-1 plasmid RK2 specific gene (korB), tetracyclines (tetM), macrolides (ermB), sulfonamides (sul1 and sul2), extended-spectrum beta-lactamases (blaCTX-M), and fluoroquinolones (qnrS). Grey crosses (×) represent genera. Permutations of 999 were run for ANOVA CCA resulting p<0.01.
Table S3. Significance of two-way ANOVA test (HRT and oxygen dosage) on the ARGs relative abundances.
